title: packages: a published dashboard or report override removes the item from the base's export, where ADR-0146 D8 item 3 says the base export is unchanged
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236, filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「发记录并立卡」 and 「相关卡 p1, 让车道处理」. ⛔ Not a claim.
QA-source: #29648 · studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display · acceptance[4]
Part of #28236 · governs: ADR-0146 D8 item 3
Reader: `domain:server` (the export read in `packages/runtime`).
Dedupe (open and closed): `base export`, `export override`, `declaresOverrideOf`. #29563 (closed, the earlier symptom) and #29600 (open, the registry cause) are the nearest. Neither says the item goes missing. **New.**
reach: any read-only base whose `.custom` pair has published a dashboard or report override.
type: Bug

**Business reason.** A customer who exports their base after customizing it gets a package with items missing. That export cannot be redeployed as the vendor's package, and nothing warns them.

## What happens

Measured on `main` at `322cf9068f`, on a real showcase boot, before and after a restart.

| type | item | base export before | base export with a published override |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| dashboard | `showcase_ops_dashboard` | 3 items | 2 items: **absent** |
| report | `showcase_hours_by_status` | 4 items | 3 items: **absent** |
| view | `showcase_task.in_progress` | 36 items | 36 items, byte-identical |

D8 item 3: `GET /packages/hotcrm.custom/export` "carries the overriding item with its `overrides` block; `GET /packages/hotcrm/export` carries the base unchanged". Removing the override brings the item back.

## Reproduce

1. On a fresh showcase, `GET /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/export`: `dashboards[]` holds `showcase_ops_dashboard`.
2. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization`; `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/showcase_ops_dashboard?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` with the item and `overrides: {package:'com.example.showcase', basedOn:'0.1.0'}`; `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase.custom/publish-drafts`.
3. Repeat step 1's read. Expected: the item byte-identical to step 1, no `overrides` key. Actual: absent.

## Why (read from source, the dev confirms)

PR #29597 added `items.filter((it) => !declaresOverrideOf(it, packageId))` at `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:3423`. It assumes the per-package layer holds both documents. On this boot the layer holds no base document for that name, so the filter leaves nothing. #29600 measured the override registered in the bare slot wearing the base's envelope.

PR #29597's pin stays green while this fails: `packages-export-base-unchanged-per-type.integration.test.ts` registers its base so that the layer lists both documents.

## Wanted

- `GET /packages/BASE/export` carries the base's own document for every type while an override is live, byte-identical to the export without it.
- A pin that fails on today's behaviour: drive a base booted as the showcase is, and assert the item is present and equal, not only that no `overrides` key appears.
- The re-run of `studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display` acceptance[4] passes on a real boot.

Serial: #29600 is in flight in the same area (os-steve), and it may remove the cause. Read its branch first, and say on this card whether it closes this one. Do not hand this card over to #29600 without measuring it on a real boot.

Links back: #29648, #29563, #29600, PR #29597, #28236, ADR-0146 D8.
